title: Kelowna Zipline and Wine Tour
includes: Zipline Park Entrance Fee & All Zipline Equipment
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Calling all adventure seekers and wine lovers! Welcome to the Kelowna Zipline and Wine Tour. We’ve combined two of the most popular things to do in Kelowna and created quite possibly the most fun way to spend a day in the Okanagan!

This adventure tour is the ultimate way to maximize your time in the Okanagan! Offering a morning of ziplining, lunch at a winery bistro and an afternoon of wine touring, this “one stop shop” is quickly becoming one of the most popular Kelowna tours we offer.

Soar through the trees at the incredible Okanagan Adventure Park where you’ll enjoy 7 ziplines over 2.5 hours of adventures and mountain views. Afterwards, enjoy a decadent winery lunch followed by tastings at 2 world class wineries in East Kelowna, West Kelowna, or Lake Country.

The Kelowna Zipline and Wine Tour includes roundtrip transportation from your Kelowna accommodation, zipline ticket, lunch reservation and all winery tasting fees. A truly authentic all inclusive Kelowna tour experience!
